memory_candidates.content: When a follow-up task is spawned off a parent's blocker (suggested_channel follow_up_task) and the parent is then revised (/revise) to absorb the very route the follow-up proposes, the follow-up's description goes stale but its status does not: it remains dispatchable with a description asking for work the parent already landed. Before planning any task with a parent_task, check the parent's archived plan, its latest commits on the named files (git log -- <file>), and its issue log for win entries postdating the blocker; if the scope is already landed, plan a verification-and-closure round with no source edit and raise a non-blocking user_decision offering abandonment, rather than re-planning the implementation.
